newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond to sell Bolivia operations.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond to sell Bolivia operations.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said on Thursday it signed an agreement to sell its operations in Bolivia to Vintage Petroleum Inc for about $31.1 million.
Ultramar Diamond owns 75 percent of Shamrock Ventures Boliviana, and Vintage would acquire the common stock of these operations, the company said.
The transaction was expected to close by December 31.

The Bolivian operations include oil and gas exploration and production interests, a gas processing plant and a 29-mile gas pipeline, the company said. These assets were targeted for sale earlier in the year, Ultramar said.
